description: This source file implements trust store management for NSS certificates within Chromium, including trust evaluation, issuer retrieval, and trust setting handling.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ResultDebugData
classes.description: Holds debug data related to trust store operations, including trust settings and slot filtering.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ListCertsResult
classes.description: Represents a certificate and its associated trust level in trust store listing results.

methods.name: GetSlotFilterType
methods.description: Determines the slot filter type based on user slot trust settings.

methods.name: GetAllSlotsAndHandlesForCert
methods.description: Retrieves all NSS slots and handles where a given certificate is present.

methods.name: IsMozillaCaPolicyProvided
methods.description: Checks if a certificate in a slot is a Mozilla CA policy provided root.

methods.name: IsCertOnlyInNSSRoots
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is only present in NSS root slots.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::Get
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a certificate, considering system trust settings.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::ListCertsIgnoringNSSRoots
methods.description: Lists all certificates ignoring NSS roots, filtering out NSS root-only certificates.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustIgnoringSystemTrust
methods.description: Determines trust for a certificate ignoring system trust settings.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustIgnoringSystemTrust
methods.description: Overload that determines trust for a CERTCertificate object.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustWithSystemTrust
methods.description: Determines trust for a certificate considering system trust.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustForNSSTrust
methods.description: Converts NSS CERTCertTrust trust flags into internal trust representations.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::IsCertAllowedForTrust
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is allowed for trust evaluation based on slot trust settings.
